facts: NASA SP-8119 states that materials susceptible to stress corrosion should not be used.
Alloy 2014-T4 is listed as susceptible to stress corrosion.
Alloy 2024-T3 is listed as susceptible to stress corrosion.
Alloy 2024-T4 is listed as susceptible to stress corrosion.
Alloy 2024-T351 is listed as susceptible to stress corrosion.
Alloy PH15-7Mo in conditions RH950 and TH1050 is listed as susceptible to stress corrosion.
Alloy 17-7PH in the annealed condition is listed as susceptible to stress corrosion.
Alloy 17-7PH in condition H900 is listed as susceptible to stress corrosion.
Alloy 17-4PH is included in the list of materials identified as susceptible to stress corrosion (the heat-treatment identifiers adjacent to 17-4PH in the source OCR are garbled and not legible).
Alloy AM350 in condition SCT850 is listed as susceptible to stress corrosion.
Alloy AM355 in condition SCT850 is listed as susceptible to stress corrosion.
